about.title: About Me
about.description: My name is <0>Lukas Moe Olsen</0>, and I am a Norwegian developer who enjoys building projects and tools. I started my career in late 2022, when I joined <1>2INF</1> at Hamar Katedralskole. Now I work as an apprentice at <2>Dyplink AS</2>, where I learn the trade in practice – from project management to full-stack development of critical systems.
